messages:
Eli (Acme IT): Hey team — trying to finish the POC onboarding. SSO domain verification is failing, keeps timing out when we validate TXT. Can you help?

maya (Sales): Sorry you're blocked, Eli — we'll sort it. Oscar from SE is looping in. Can you paste the exact TXT you added and the provider? :eyes:

Eli (Acme IT): We added `_redwood-verif.acme.com TXT \"rv=abc12345\"` at our DNS provider (CloudDNS). TTL is 300. Validation error: \"no txt record found\".

oscar (Solutions Eng): Thanks. Two quick checks: 1) confirm there is no CNAME on `_redwood-verif.acme.com`, 2) any DNS flattening/aliasing on the zone root? Also try `dig +short TXT _redwood-verif.acme.com` from your laptop and paste output.

Eli (Acme IT): dig returns nothing from my workstation, but `dig` from our CI (GCP) shows the TXT present. Could be DNS propagation from registrar side.

oscar (Solutions Eng): That matches a TTL/proxy issue. If CI sees it, our verifier should too — but our hosted verifier queries from us-east, so check if your DNS geo-replicates slowly. Temporary workaround: can you add the TXT at the apex as well and keep TTL low? Also avoid aliasing like ALIAS/ANAME for that host.

rahul (Infra): FYI, for the Dedicated POC we can also bypass domain TXT verification if you can provision a signed SAML metadata assertion from your IdP — we can accept that as proof of domain control for short-term POCs. Will need legal approval.

liam (Account Exec): Pricing note: If you need Dedicated capacity for the POC to test failover and throughput, we can add a 30-day trial Dedicated seat at a discounted rate — ping me and I’ll attach a credit. Hosted POC (standard) has no dedicated isolation.

Eli (Acme IT): Another blocker: SCIM group sync. We need certain groups mapped to RBAC roles (engineering -> dev-role, security -> admin-role). How granular can SCIM be?

oscar (Solutions Eng): SCIM supports group membership sync and custom group attributes. We generally map SCIM groups -> Redwood roles via group name regex. Example config:```json
{
  "scim": {
    "endpoint": "https://acme-idp/scim/v2/",
    "bearer_token": "<redacted>",
    "group_mapping": [{"pattern": "^acme-eng$","role": "dev-role"},{"pattern": "^acme-sec$","role": "admin-role"}]
  }
}
```

nora (Security): Quick security checklist: we need (1) SAML NameID format decision (persistent vs transient), (2) audit log retention required by Acme, and (3) assurance that SCIM traffic is over mTLS or TLS with cert pinning. Eli — what does your compliance team ask for retention and NameID?

Eli (Acme IT): They want NameID persistent and audit logs retained for 13 months. SCIM over TLS is OK. Also want a written failover plan for IdP outages — what do you support?

oscar (Solutions Eng): We recommend persistent NameID for account linking. We can support transient but that complicates linking. Audit logs: hosted retains 90 days by default, enterprise can request 13 months (we ship to S3 or SIEM). For IdP outage: options are (A) cached session fallback (short-term tokens + KV cache), (B) fallback to a secondary IdP (we support multiple SAML IdPs per tenant), (C) emergency bypass with short-lived service accounts for ops — requires legal signoff.

nora (Security): Also adding: we need to confirm whether your user provisioning requires SCIM full sync or just incremental PATCHes — full sync impacts rate limits. Oscar, please coordinate rate-limit policy for their group sizes.

oscar (Solutions Eng): Noted. For the POC, we can increase rate limits for the tenant for 14 days. Please send approximate group counts.

Eli (Acme IT): Group sizes: ~1k users in engineering groups, ~120 in security.

liam (Account Exec): I'll log the POC commercial change (temp dedicated capacity + extended rate limits). Oscar — can you confirm estimated additional monthly cost if we continue Dedicated after POC?

oscar (Solutions Eng): I'll estimate after the test run. For now, plan for 2x baseline throughput to be safe.

legalbot: Heads-up — DPA amendment required for extended log retention and cross-border processing. Maya, I'll draft and send the clause to Acme legal.

maya (Sales): Thanks. Eli, can you confirm who on your side will sign the DPA addendum? Also confirm whether the proof-of-domain flow with signed metadata is OK — rahul mentioned legal OK needed.

Eli (Acme IT): I'll confirm signer and try the signed metadata route today.

deploy-bot: POC environment provisioned (poc-acme-206543): models/endpoint created, SCIM webhook endpoint registered.

oscar (Solutions Eng): Quick checklist for next steps: 1) Eli to try signed metadata or add apex TXT, 2) Eli to share `dig` outputs and group counts (done), 3) Maya/Liam to handle DPA/commercial adjustments, 4) SE to bump rate limits and enable secondary IdP config for failover testing.

maya (Sales): Sounds good — I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a 30-min sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Eli (Acme IT): Thanks all — will update after I try the signed metadata.
